verdict.rationale: Lium's official CLI is hosted in a public GitHub repository (Datura-ai/lium), and its agent skill file is served from a public GitHub repo (Datura-ai/lium-skill), so at least part of the client-side source can be read. The pack never names a license, and nothing covers the source of the core marketplace or platform. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g. MIT or Apache), evidence that the platform or backend source is public, and independent confirmation of repo openness and licensing.
